pages: Wat, a freckled boy of eleven with tousled brown hair, a blue smock patched at one knee, stoops by the stone trough and tips a galvanised pail into it, watching the water come. Middle distance: his boots in the mud, the sheep yard wall he has been mending. Background: the village green at Brent, dry hard ground. Bright early light, long soft shadows.

Old Frisk, a shepherd of seventy with white hair and a bowed back, a brown sheepskin coat and a green scarf, stands in the lane with his crook planted in the ground and one hand lifted as he talks. Middle distance: the crook head, a gate post. Background: the lane running down past the sheep yard. Late afternoon light, warm and low.

Ada, a brisk woman of forty with black hair pinned up, a green apron over a brown dress, stands beside the village tap with one hand flat on the post, looking down the bare lane. Middle distance: the tap spout, its stone trough, a galvanised pail on the grass. Background: the green at Brent, the dry stone of the beck. Hard noon light, short shadows on the grass.

A horse cart stands on the green at Brent with its shafts toward the camera and one barrel lashed on the bed. Middle distance: Coll, a carter of fifty with grizzled hair in a dusty brown coat, soft hat held in front of him, looking up the lane. Background: the village green, dry hard ground, midday. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Foreground: a stone trough under a village tap with a stub of white chalk lying on its edge. Middle: Wat, a freckled boy of eleven with tousled brown hair, a blue smock patched at one knee, seen from behind at the tap, looking up the lane. Background: the village green at Brent, a bare hedge. Light: flat noon on dry ground.

Ada, a brisk woman of forty with black hair pinned up, a green apron over a brown dress, crouches at the trough with a stub of white chalk, marking the stone for each pail she has counted, lips moving. Middle distance: the chalk in her hand, a galvanised pail on the grass. Background: the tap and the green at noon. Bleached light, short shadows.

Coll, a carter of fifty with grizzled hair, a dusty brown coat, stands on the green with his soft hat held in both hands in front of him and his eyes down upon it. Middle distance: his cart shafts, the tap post. Background: the green at Brent, the lane beyond. Flat afternoon light, thin blue shade.

Old Frisk, a shepherd of seventy with white hair and a bowed back, a brown sheepskin coat and a green scarf, stands square on the green with his crook held upright against his shoulder, chin lifted, waiting. Middle distance: the crook head, a low stone wall. Background: the lane and the sheep yard. Low warm light, long soft shadows.

Wat, a freckled boy of eleven with tousled brown hair, a blue smock patched at one knee, stands on the green with his chin up and his hands loose at his sides, speaking out steadily, his eyes on nothing in front of him. Middle distance: the chalked gate post, his pail on the grass. Background: the tap and the lane. Long afternoon light, going warm.

Bess, a lean black and white sheepdog with a rough coat and a pale ruff, is up off the ground with her head thrown back and her mouth open wide, barking hard, her front paws clear of the turf. Middle distance: her long shadow on the green, a galvanised pail on its side. Background: the tap post and the lane. Low evening light, long shadows.

Old Frisk, a shepherd of seventy with white hair and a bowed back, a brown sheepskin coat and a green scarf, walks away up the lane with his crook across his shoulder and one hand open at his side as he talks. Middle distance: the crook head, the gate post. Background: the sheep yard wall, the lane above. Evening, one warm light against blue shade.

Ada, a brisk woman of forty with black hair pinned up, a green apron over a brown dress, lays one chalk-dusted finger against the gate post and runs it slowly down the tallies, her face very still. Middle distance: the strokes of chalk, the trough below. Background: the green at Brent, the lane going dark. Last light, low and warm.
